decision: Build a generic multi-agent adversarial debate framework

claims.title: Generic adversarial debate is differentiated
claims.statement: A generic builder-versus-adversary multi-agent framework is sufficiently differentiated from existing orchestration and debate systems to justify a new project.

challenges.title: Direct prior art covers the core thesis
challenges.argument: Existing systems already provide multi-agent debate, critic/reflection loops, and adversarial orchestration. The proposed generic framework does not establish a differentiated control lifecycle.
challenges.resolves_if: Demonstrate a materially different decision lifecycle or control mechanism that is not simply another debate/orchestration framework.

review_rounds.result: A fatal direct-prior-art challenge invalidated the generic framework thesis.

termination.reason: The decision already has an unresolved FATAL challenge; additional argument cannot make this proposal actionable without changing the proposal itself.

reasons: Fatal unresolved challenge: Direct prior art covers the core thesis
